x-gmx-notice.text: Show song words under your church's own CCLI licence and report what you use. The plugin shows the licence number you give here but does not report anything.
x-gmx-notice.label: About CCLI licences

default_translation.title: Default translation
default_translation.description: The translation a lookup uses when none is named: kjv, web, or the id of one you imported.

verse_numbers.title: Verse numbers
verse_numbers.description: Show small verse numbers when a slide holds more than one verse.

ccli_licence.title: CCLI licence number
ccli_licence.description: Your church's CCLI licence number, shown in the credit line with song words. Empty for none.

ccli_footer.title: Song credit line
ccli_footer.description: Where the song credit (title, author, copyright, CCLI numbers) shows: on the first and last slide, on every slide, or nowhere.

bible_style.title: Bible style
bible_style.description: The style verses start in. The panel changes it while the plugin runs.

api_bible_key.title: API.Bible key
api_bible_key.description: Your own key from scripture.api.bible, to read a translation you may show but cannot download. Empty for none.

stage_bind.title: Stage display address
stage_bind.description: The address the stage display listens on once it is started. 0.0.0.0 lets a tablet on the same network open it; 127.0.0.1 keeps it on this machine.

stage_port.title: Stage display port
stage_port.description: The port the stage display listens on once it is started.

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where the song library and imported translations are kept. Empty means a data folder beside the installed plugin, which survives updates.
